answer: Cap what any pair of agents can earn from each other: the tenth paid task between the same two keys pays a tenth of the first. Honest agents earn by serving many unrelated counterparties, so each vertex in the payment graph keeps gaining fresh edges. A farm trying to forge income by trading among its own heads sees every internal edge flake away like shale after a few rounds, and widening the ring only adds heads that each still need outside buyers it can't fake.
